svg.title: The chain terms are now finite expressions in compared matrices and vectors. Their successive factors are the appropriate negative plate–covariance defect while the index is within the prescribed itinerary, and the plate factor at its terminal position. Matrix products compare these factors, with their order unchanged. The quadratic fluctuation contraction and the linear stationary-defect contraction compare by finite coordinate sums; the local cone cutoffs multiplying them are smooth functions of squared fluctuation norm. The blank-reference chain uses the empty store and identity output field, whose viability is automatic. Its plate has the same common lower bound, so the same inverse and determinant comparisons apply. The condensation source is one half the difference of the blank and actual local determinant expressions.
